threshold_rationale: Threshold 0.80 was selected as the optimal operating balance between straight-through processing and risk mitigation in high-value insurance onboarding. Printed identity documents typically score > 0.95 when formats pass validation. Handwritten fields (IFSC, bank account, TIN/PAN, dates, places) carry inherently higher ambiguity; setting the threshold at 0.80 ensures that any field with optical occlusion, non-standard cursive, or regex/format validation failure is surfaced immediately for human review without unnecessarily flagging clean handwriting.
